dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyText: Create a p4d server to get started.

instances.title: Instances
instances.loadError: The instances could not be loaded: {message}
instances.selectionHint: Select servers to start, stop or restart them together.

stop.title: Stop all the servers?
stop.text: Every running server is stopped. Users cannot connect until the servers start again.

restart.title: Restart all the running servers?
restart.text: Users are disconnected while each server restarts. Stopped servers stay stopped.

stop.title: Stop {name}? | Stop {count} servers?
stop.text: Its users are disconnected and cannot connect until it starts again. | Their users are disconnected and cannot connect until they start again.

restart.title: Restart {name}? | Restart {count} servers?
restart.text: Its users are disconnected while it restarts. | Their users are disconnected while they restart.

enableMaintenance.title: Restart {name} in maintenance mode? | Restart {count} servers in maintenance mode?
enableMaintenance.text: Its users are disconnected while it restarts. Then it only allows the commands that do not need a client workspace: users can no longer sync or submit. | Their users are disconnected while they restart. Then they only allow the commands that do not need a client workspace: users can no longer sync or submit.

disableMaintenance.title: Restart {name} in normal mode? | Restart {count} servers in normal mode?
disableMaintenance.text: Its users are disconnected while it restarts. | Their users are disconnected while they restart.

legacyProfiles.title: Servers of the HelixCoreServer package
legacyProfiles.text: These servers were set up with the Perforce P4 Server (p4d) package. Import them to manage them here. Their root and their depots stay where they are.
legacyProfiles.loadError: The servers to import could not be loaded: {message}
legacyProfiles.dismissError: The server could not be dismissed: {message}
legacyProfiles.dismissHint: Hide this server for good. It is left untouched.

instance.autoStartHint: Starts the server whenever the manager starts, unless it already runs.
instance.autoStartError: The setting could not be saved: {message}
instance.maintenanceModeOn: On: the server only allows the commands that do not need a client workspace. Users cannot sync or submit.
instance.maintenanceModeOff: Off. In maintenance mode, the server only allows the commands that do not need a client workspace.

health.title: Health
health.loadError: The reports could not be loaded: {message}

stateText.unknown: Run a check to learn the state of the database.
stateText.healthy: As of the last complete check, on {date}, no problems are known.
stateText.problems: As of the last complete check, on {date}, {count} problem is known. | As of the last complete check, on {date}, {count} problems are known.
stateText.newerIncomplete: A later check did not run to its end: see the reports below.
stateText.advice: Do not replay the fix journal without the advice of Perforce Support. Save a checkpoint and your archives before any repair.

progress.estimate: The progress counts tables, not time: it can stay long on a large table.

checkHints.Validate: Reads the structure of each table of the database (p4d -xv).
checkHints.CrossCheck: Compares the tables that refer to each other (p4d -xx).

runDialog.title: Check {name}
runDialog.text: The checks only read the database: nothing is repaired or changed.
runDialog.warningRunning: The server is stopped before the check, which disconnects its users, then started again at the end. On a large database this can take hours, so prefer a quiet time.
runDialog.warningStopped: The server is stopped, and it cannot be started until the check ends.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this report?
deleteDialog.text: The report of {date} leaves the list, and this cannot be undone. If the health of the server rests on it, the state and the fix journal stay until a later check replaces them.
deleteDialog.error: The report could not be deleted: {message}

notifications.healthy: {name} is healthy: the check found no problems.
notifications.problems: The check of {name} found {count} problem. | The check of {name} found {count} problems.
notifications.failed: The check of {name} could not run to its end.

steps.create-specs: Create the depots, the server spec and the typemap
steps.update-server-address: Update the address of the server spec
steps.scan-server-files: List the files of the server
steps.restore-metadata: Download the checkpoint and the journals
steps.replay-checkpoint: Replay the checkpoint and the journals
steps.locate-restored-files: Place the files of the point
steps.start-server-maintenance: Start the server in maintenance mode

serverDirectoryCaseWarning: {variant} already exists, and only the case of its name tells it from {path}. Both folders are kept apart, but they are easy to mix up, especially from Windows.

createInstance.title: New server
createInstance.name: Name
createInstance.nameHint: Also used as the server ID, which stays the same if the server is renamed later. The server ID can be changed on its own.
createInstance.versionsError: The p4d versions could not be loaded: {message}
createInstance.serverDirectoryHint: Empty or missing. Holds the root, the journals, the logs and the depot files. Leave empty for a folder named after the instance in the servers folder.
createInstance.sslHint: Encrypts the connections. Clients trust the server once.
createInstance.caseSensitiveHint: Cannot be changed once the server exists.
createInstance.unicodeHint: Cannot be undone once the server exists.
createInstance.autoStartHint: Starts the server whenever the manager starts. Can be changed later.
createInstance.superUserHint: The administrator of the new server. Until you add other users, it is the only account that can manage it.
createInstance.passwordHint: Stored encrypted: the manager uses this account to administer the server.
createInstance.error: The server could not be created: {message}

rules.nameFormat: Start with a letter, then up to 31 letters, digits, '-' or '_'.
rules.userNameFormat: Start with a letter, then up to 63 letters, digits, '.', '-' or '_'.
rules.passwordStrength: Use at least 8 characters, from at least two of: upper case, lower case, digits or symbols.

createInstance.buildHint: An exact build from the archive.

directoryPicker.title: Choose a folder
directoryPicker.browse: Browse the folders of the server
directoryPicker.loadError: The folders could not be listed: {message}
directoryPicker.newFolderHint: Only added to the path: the folder is created when the path is used.
directoryPicker.readOnlyFolder: The manager cannot create files or folders here.

rules.nameFormat: A name cannot contain slashes, start or end with a space, nor be '.' or '..'.
rules.nameTaken: A folder already has this name.

importInstance.title: Import {name}
importInstance.rootHint: Kept as it is. The server ID stored in the database is kept too.
importInstance.versionHint: The database is upgraded to this version and cannot go back: choose the version the server ran, or a newer one.
importInstance.caseSensitiveHint: Must match the way the server was created. Suggested from its profile.
importInstance.unicodeNote: The Unicode mode is read from the database.
importInstance.sslNote: The server listens with SSL. It keeps the key and the certificate in the ssl folder of its root, so clients keep trusting it.
importInstance.warning: Stop the server in the HelixCoreServer package first. A checkpoint of the database is saved to the folder of the instance before the upgrade.
importInstance.error: The server could not be imported: {message}

editInstance.title: Edit {name}
editInstance.nameHint: Only the name in the manager changes. The server keeps its server ID and the prefix of its journals. Change the server ID from the details of the server.
editInstance.error: The server could not be changed: {message}

superUser.title: Super user
superUser.intro: The manager uses this account to administer the server: it must have super access. Its password is stored encrypted. Nothing changes in P4: to change the password, change it in P4 first, then enter the new one here.
superUser.stoppedNote: The server is stopped: the account is checked once it runs.

warning.title: The manager cannot administer this server
warning.missing: No super user is stored for this server. Set one so that the manager can administer it.
warning.InvalidCredentials: The server refuses the stored user name or password. If the password was changed in P4, enter the new one.
warning.PasswordExpired: The password of the stored super user has expired. Change it in P4, then enter the new one here.
warning.InsufficientAccess: The stored user does not have super access. Give it super access in the protections table, or choose another account.

superUser.checkError: The super user could not be checked: {message}
superUser.error: The super user could not be saved: {message}

upgradeInstance.title: Upgrade {name}
upgradeInstance.versionHint: The latest build of the version is installed, unless you pick one of the archive. The database cannot go back to an older version.
upgradeInstance.warningRunning: The server is stopped while its database is upgraded: its users are disconnected until it starts again. No backup of the database is taken: make one first.
upgradeInstance.warningStopped: The server stays stopped. No backup of the database is taken: make one first.
upgradeInstance.upToDate: {name} already runs the latest build, p4d {version}. Nothing was changed.

convertToUnicode.title: Convert {name} to Unicode?
convertToUnicode.text: This cannot be undone: a server in Unicode mode cannot go back. A checkpoint of the database is saved to the folder of the instance first.
convertToUnicode.clients: Clients then need a character set (P4CHARSET). Check your triggers and scripts too.
convertToUnicode.invalidMetadata: If the metadata holds text that is not valid UTF-8, p4d refuses the conversion and names the tables. The server then stays as it was.
convertToUnicode.warningRunning: The server is stopped during the conversion: its users are disconnected until it starts again.

changeServerId.title: Change the server ID of {name}
changeServerId.text: p4d stores its server ID in its root, and its server spec is named after it. Both change; the name of the server in the manager and the prefix of its journals stay the same.
changeServerId.superUserNote: The server spec is renamed as the stored super user.
changeServerId.warningRunning: The server is restarted: its users are disconnected until it starts again.
changeServerId.warningStopped: The server is started to rename its server spec, then stopped again.
changeServerId.superUserRequired: Store a usable super user first: the server spec is renamed as it.
changeServerId.error: The server ID could not be changed: {message}

rules.format: Start with a letter, then up to 31 letters, digits, '-' or '_'.
rules.unchanged: Enter a server ID other than the current one.

changePort.title: Change the port of {name}
changePort.text: p4d listens on the new port once it starts again. Clients must then connect to the new port: update their P4PORT.
changePort.superUserNote: The address of the server spec is updated as the stored super user.
changePort.noSuperUserNote: No usable super user is stored: the address of the server spec is left as it is.
changePort.warningRunning: The server is restarted: its users are disconnected until it starts again on the new port.
changePort.warningStopped: The server is started on the new port to update its server spec, then stopped again.
changePort.error: The port could not be changed: {message}

rules.unchanged: Enter a port other than the current one.

deleteInstance.title: Delete {name}?
deleteInstance.text: The server is stopped if it runs, then removed from the manager with what the manager keeps for it. This cannot be undone.
deleteInstance.deleteFilesHint: Deletes what the server uses, wherever its folder is: its root, depots, checkpoints, journals and logs. A folder that holds other files is kept.
deleteInstance.keptFiles: The files of the server stay on disk, in {path}. A log the manager kept for it is moved to the logs folder there.
deleteInstance.error: The server could not be deleted: {message}

builds.title: p4d builds
builds.text: Every build is kept compressed in the archive. The builds that servers run are also extracted, ready to run.
builds.loadError: The builds could not be loaded: {message}
builds.empty: The archive is empty. Fetch a build from Perforce, or import one from your computer.
builds.protectHint: The retention policy never removes a protected build.
builds.protectError: The build could not be changed: {message}
builds.inUse: This build cannot be deleted while a server uses it.
builds.downloadError: The last fetch from Perforce failed: {message}
builds.downloading: The manager is fetching the current build of {release} from Perforce.

buildPolicy.title: Archive policy
buildPolicy.autoDownloadHint: The manager checks Perforce for new builds of the chosen releases.
buildPolicy.releasesHint: Every new patch of these releases is downloaded.
buildPolicy.keepLatestHint: The newest ones. The builds that servers use and the protected ones are always kept.
buildPolicy.error: The policy could not be saved: {message}
buildPolicy.loadError: The policy could not be loaded: {message}

rules.interval: Enter a number of hours between 1 and 720.

importBuild.title: Import a p4d build
importBuild.text: The manager runs p4d to read its version and build: it must be a p4d for the platform of the manager.
importBuild.packageHint: The server package of Perforce, or any tar archive that holds p4d and p4.
importBuild.compressing: The build is compressed before it is added: this can take a minute.
importBuild.error: The build could not be imported: {message}

downloadBuild.title: Fetch a p4d build from Perforce
downloadBuild.text: The manager downloads the current build of the release from Perforce and keeps it in its archive. Perforce only offers the latest patch of each release.

deleteBuild.title: Delete p4d {version}?
deleteBuild.textFtp: Perforce may no longer offer this build: once deleted, it may be gone for good.
deleteBuild.textImported: This build was imported: only a new import brings it back.
deleteBuild.error: The build could not be deleted: {message}

backupDestinations.text: Each destination is an encrypted backup repository on a storage. Every instance chooses its own destinations; a backup goes to all of them at once, and each one only receives what it lacks.
backupDestinations.loadError: The destinations could not be loaded: {message}
backupDestinations.empty: No destination yet. Add one to back up the instances.
backupDestinations.removeText: The destination leaves the daemon. Its repository and its backups stay on the storage, and can be attached again with the passphrase.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.pathHint: Absolute path on the machine of the daemon, such as a mounted share.
dialog.prefixHint: Folder of the repository in the bucket or the container. Optional.
dialog.endpointHint: URL of the S3-compatible API, such as https://s3.eu-central-003.backblazeb2.com.
dialog.forcePathStyle: Put the bucket in the path of the URLs
dialog.storageClassHint: Such as STANDARD_IA. Leave empty for the default.
dialog.serviceAccountJsonHint: Paste the JSON key file of a service account that can write to the bucket.
dialog.portHint: Leave empty for 21, or 990 with implicit TLS.
dialog.insecureFtp: Without TLS, the password and the transfers go in clear on the network. The backups stay encrypted.
dialog.certificateFingerprintHint: SHA-256 fingerprint of a self-signed certificate to trust. Leave empty to validate the certificate as usual.
dialog.passphraseHint: At least 12 characters. It encrypts the backups.
dialog.passphraseWarning: Keep the passphrase somewhere else, such as a password manager. It is the only way to read the backups from another daemon: without it, they are lost.

backups.title: Backups
backups.fullHint: A checkpoint of the database, with every archive.
backups.incrementalHint: A rotation of the journal, on top of the latest backup at each destination.
backups.loadError: The backups could not be loaded: {message}

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.text: Where the backups of this instance go. A backup goes to all of them at once.
destinations.none: No destination is chosen: the instance is not backed up.
destinations.label: Destinations

run.title: Backup of {date}
run.verifyHint: A verification checks that every object is there; in depth, it reads them all back, which downloads the whole backup.
run.verifiedDeep: Verified in depth on {date}: {count} objects, nothing wrong.
run.verificationError: The verification of {date} could not run: {error}
run.verifyStarted: Verification of the backup at {name} begun.

notifications.PartiallySucceeded: Backup of {name} done, but some destinations failed.

history.title: Restores
history.problems: p4 verify found {count} problem: | p4 verify found {count} problems:

dialog.title: Restore a backup
dialog.replaceWarning: The server of {name} stops, and its database and archives are replaced by the ones of the backup. Everything submitted since is lost. The current data is kept aside until the restore succeeds, and put back if it fails.
dialog.confirmMismatch: Type the name of the server.
dialog.newHint: The new server gets the database, the archives and the users of the backup, with its case handling and Unicode mode. Its server ID is its name.
dialog.sslHint: With the certificate of the backup when it has one.
dialog.licenseHint: A license is bound to the address of the machine it was issued for.
dialog.superUserHint: A super user of the backed-up server, with its password at the time of the backup. The manager stores it.

points.title: Backups at {name}
points.text: Read from the destination itself: the backups of servers this manager never knew are listed too. Each one can become a new server.
points.loadError: The backups could not be listed: {message}

notifications.SucceededWithProblems: Restore of {name} done, with problems to look at.

login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your P4 servers

setup.title: Create the administrator account
setup.intro: No account exists yet. Create the first one: it can manage the P4 servers and add other accounts. Until then, anybody who reaches this page can create it.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.intro: Your other sessions end. This one goes on.

rules.userNameFormat: Starts with a letter or a digit, then up to 63 letters, digits, '.', '-', '_' or '@'.

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check that P4 Server Manager runs, then try again.

users.text: Accounts that sign in to the web interface. Every account has all rights on the servers; only administrators manage the accounts. The command line needs no account: run 'p4sm user set-password' on the server to reset a lost password.
users.passwordIntro: The sessions of this account end.
users.removeText: Its user can no longer sign in, and its sessions end.
users.removeSelfText: This is your account: you are signed out.
users.demoteSelfText: You can no longer manage the accounts. Another administrator can give you this right back.
